dtos.name: Job
dtos.doc: A leased queue job.

fields.name: traceparent
fields.doc: Validated W3C traceparent stored outside the payload.

dtos.name: Decision
dtos.doc: A rate-limit decision.

dtos.name: ApiKey
dtos.doc: A freshly minted API key whose secret is shown once.

fields.name: scopes
fields.doc: Application-owned authorization labels; Forge stores but does not interpret them.

dtos.name: QueueDepth
dtos.doc: Approximate queue depth.

fields.name: oldest_visible_age_ms
fields.doc: Age of the oldest visible job, or null when none is visible.

dtos.name: DeadLetterInfo
dtos.doc: Payload-free operator metadata for one dead letter.

dtos.name: BatchEnqueueResult
dtos.doc: Ordered result for one item in a non-atomic batch enqueue.

fields.name: job_id
fields.doc: Effective deterministic job ID on success.

fields.name: error_code
fields.doc: Stable Forge error code on failure.

fields.name: retryable
fields.doc: Whether retrying the failed item may succeed unchanged.

dtos.name: QueueStats
dtos.doc: Counter-based queue activity and indexed age estimate.

fields.name: oldest_visible_age_ms
fields.doc: Indexed age of the oldest visible job.

dtos.name: DeadLetterPage
dtos.doc: A bounded page of dead letters.

dtos.name: RedriveBatchResult
dtos.doc: Result of one bounded batch redrive.

dtos.name: OutboxRelayReport
dtos.doc: Result and backlog snapshot from one outbox relay pass.

dtos.name: ScanPage
dtos.doc: A page of keys and an opaque continuation cursor.

dtos.name: BlobInfo
dtos.doc: Complete object metadata returned by head.

fields.name: cache_control
fields.doc: HTTP cache policy stored with the object.

fields.name: content_disposition
fields.doc: HTTP download disposition stored with the object.

fields.name: checksum_sha256
fields.doc: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest, independent of the provider ETag.

fields.name: server_side_encryption
fields.doc: Provider-managed encryption label when reported by S3.

dtos.name: BlobSummary
dtos.doc: Lightweight object metadata returned by list; content type and user metadata require head.

fields.name: etag
fields.doc: Opaque provider version token; not necessarily an MD5 digest.

dtos.name: BlobPage
dtos.doc: A page of blob summaries and an opaque continuation cursor.

dtos.name: ConditionalBlobGet
dtos.doc: Atomic conditional-read result that distinguishes missing and not-modified.

fields.name: etag
fields.doc: Opaque version returned for found or not_modified.

dtos.name: MultipartUpload
dtos.doc: Opaque provider-native server-mediated multipart upload handle.

fields.name: create_only
fields.doc: Whether completion must create a new key.

dtos.name: MultipartPart
dtos.doc: One uploaded multipart part receipt.

fields.name: etag
fields.doc: Opaque part receipt passed back unchanged.

dtos.name: ProxyPresign
dtos.doc: Forge proxy-signed request whose server-side proxy can enforce an upload-size ceiling.

fields.name: url
fields.doc: Bearer credential; redact its query string from logs and traces.

fields.name: max_bytes
fields.doc: Upload ceiling enforced by the Forge proxy; zero for GET.

dtos.name: NativePresign
dtos.doc: Provider-native presigned request. Native PUT does not portably enforce a maximum body size.

fields.name: url
fields.doc: Bearer credential; redact its query string from logs and traces.

fields.name: required_headers
fields.doc: Signed headers the caller must send exactly.

dtos.name: ScheduleInfo
dtos.doc: A registered schedule.

fields.name: paused
fields.doc: Whether this named schedule is paused.

fields.name: max_catch_up
fields.doc: Maximum missed occurrences dispatched by catch_up; zero otherwise.

dtos.name: SchedulePage
dtos.doc: A page of schedules and an opaque continuation cursor.

dtos.name: SchedulerDiagnostics
dtos.doc: Bounded operational state for one scheduler namespace.

fields.name: lag_ms
fields.doc: Age of the oldest unpaused due occurrence.

fields.name: last_successful_tick_ms
fields.doc: UTC Unix timestamp of the latest successful pass.

dtos.name: Session
dtos.doc: Validated session metadata.

dtos.name: ApiKeyInfo
dtos.doc: Non-secret API-key metadata.

fields.name: scopes
fields.doc: Application-owned authorization labels; Forge stores but does not interpret them.

dtos.name: TokenConsumption
dtos.doc: The user and bounded opaque payload returned by atomic one-time-token consumption.

fields.name: payload
fields.doc: Opaque bytes stored with the token.

dtos.name: FlagEvaluation
dtos.doc: Typed OpenFeature-style flag result with stable evaluation details.

fields.name: value_type
fields.doc: boolean, string, integer, float, object, array, or null.

fields.name: error_code
fields.doc: Error category when the default was used.

dtos.name: ConfigEntry
dtos.doc: One config value returned in the same order as its requested key.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: Resolved value, or null when unset.

dtos.name: FlagEvaluationRequest
dtos.doc: One typed bulk flag evaluation with a caller-owned correlation id.

fields.name: context_json
fields.doc: Optional JSON object of invocation-local OpenFeature context fields.

dtos.name: FlagEvaluationEntry
dtos.doc: One typed bulk flag result in request order.

dtos.name: ConfigSnapshot
dtos.doc: Read-only caller-scoped config view with an explicit expiry and secret-handling declaration.

fields.name: expires_at_ms
fields.doc: Hard Unix epoch millisecond staleness boundary.

fields.name: config
fields.doc: Only the exact requested config keys.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: Pre-evaluated flag requests; no offline re-evaluation.

dtos.name: BackendInfo
dtos.doc: Resolved backend capability information.

dtos.name: BackendHealth
dtos.doc: One redacted live backend probe result.

fields.name: error_category
fields.doc: Stable category, never a raw provider error.

dtos.name: HealthReport
dtos.doc: Separate process liveness and dependency readiness.

dtos.name: MetricSample
dtos.doc: One bounded-cardinality per-instance metric sample.

dtos.name: DiagnosticCheck
dtos.doc: One secret-safe deployment or operator diagnostic.

dtos.name: DiagnosticsReport
dtos.doc: Bounded configuration, schema, permission, reachability, skew, and safety checks.

fields.name: ready
fields.doc: False when any required check fails.

dtos.name: MigrationReport
dtos.doc: Structured migration outcome for one distinct PostgreSQL target.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: Safe logical target name, never a connection string.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: pending, applied, locked, incompatible, or failed

fields.name: target_version
fields.doc: Newest migration embedded in this library.

fields.name: lock_holder
fields.doc: Safe PostgreSQL session identity when another migrator owns the lock.
